question: How many components are there in total?
How many components are in each status?
expected_sql: select current_status, count(*) from components group by current_status

question: How many components are currently flagged?
expected_sql: select count(*) from components where current_status = 'flagged'

question: How many components have been completed?
expected_sql: select count(*) from components where current_status = 'completed'

question: Which components are currently in progress?
expected_sql: select name from components where current_status = 'in_progress'

question: List the names of the flagged components.
expected_sql: select name from components where current_status = 'flagged'

question: How many status changes happened at each workstation?
expected_sql: select w.name, count(*) from status_logs s join workstations w on w.id = s.workstation_id group by w.name

question: Which workstation has the most status changes?
expected_sql: select w.name, count(*) c from status_logs s join workstations w on w.id = s.workstation_id group by w.name order by c desc limit 1

question: How many distinct components has each workstation handled?
expected_sql: select w.name, count(distinct s.component_id) from status_logs s join workstations w on w.id = s.workstation_id group by w.name

question: Which workstation has handled the most distinct components?
expected_sql: select w.name, count(distinct s.component_id) c from status_logs s join workstations w on w.id = s.workstation_id group by w.name order by c desc limit 1

question: How many status changes happened in the last 24 hours?
expected_sql: select count(*) from status_logs where timestamp >= now() - interval '24 hours'

question: How many components were completed in the last 7 days?
expected_sql: select count(*) from status_logs where to_status = 'completed' and timestamp >= now() - interval '7 days'

question: How many status changes happened per day?
expected_sql: select date_trunc('day', timestamp) d, count(*) from status_logs group by d order by d

question: What is the average number of status changes per component?
expected_sql: select avg(c) from (select component_id, count(*) c from status_logs group by component_id) t

question: How many components are currently at each workstation?
expected_sql: select current_workstation_name, count(*) from components where current_workstation_id is not null group by current_workstation_name

question: What is the longest time a component waited between two status changes?
expected_sql: select max(gap) from (select timestamp - lag(timestamp) over (partition by component_id order by timestamp) gap from status_logs) t

question: What is the average time between consecutive status changes at each workstation?
expected_sql: select w.name, avg(gap) from (select workstation_id, timestamp - lag(timestamp) over (partition by component_id order by timestamp) gap from status_logs) g join workstations w on w.id = g.workstation_id where gap is not null group by w.name
